TUN.note: The document covers meteorological use of Meteosat data for flood and drought early warning and states no farming service.

facts.fact: The Institut National de la Meteorologie says it has used Meteosat data since the 1980s, progressively upgrading its receiving and exploitation systems.
The Institut National de la Meteorologie presented that satellite imagery and cloud-top alert products improve its nowcasting and real-time risk management of convective storms.
The Institut National de la Meteorologie presented the role of EUMETSAT products in supporting Tunisia's flood and drought early warning systems.
